lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four to five visible horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots, with a denser, more stochastic arrangement of smaller spots in the anterior region near the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the primary spot rows, creating a faint grid-like visual structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal ridge feature located in the upper-third of the visible flank, exhibiting a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient across its longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-10 distinct high-luminance spots of varying sizes, primarily distributed along the anterior-distal margin.
